patch_description: Replace the linear scan for the least-loaded non-full pack with a min-heap. The packing policy remains the same cardinality-constrained LPT greedy policy, so it preserves its established load-balancing behavior, but reduces pack selection from O(num_packs) to O(log(num_packs)) per group. Converting each layer's scalar weights and assignments to Python lists also avoids repeated CPU tensor scalar indexing in the hot loop.
